item.guhs.safari_verblijfsbord.lore: Place it and a family moves in: a male, a female and two little ones. Vahoeg!
item.guhs.safari_verblijfsbord.leeg: (no animal: get one in the Safaripark gift shop)
item.guhs.safari_verblijfsbord.terrarium: Place it and a little glass tank appears, with the creatures living inside. Cosy indoors too!
item.guhs.safari_reuzen_ei.lore: From your ostrich! Bake it in a furnace.
item.guhs.safari_reuzen_omelet.lore: Enough for the whole family. Njeg!
block.guhs.safari_ooievaarsbus.lore: Friends' storks drop their parcels in here.
gui.guhs.verblijf.verblijf.uitleg: The animals always stay inside this area, even without a fence. You may build one yourself, of course!
gui.guhs.verblijf.binnenkort: Coming soon! The Bouwkeet update brings this.
gui.guhs.verblijf.voer: Likes to eat: %s (Safari food counts double)
gui.guhs.verblijf.cadeautjes.uitleg: Happy animals sometimes leave a little gift here.
gui.guhs.verblijf.cadeautjes.leeg: No gifts yet. Keep them happy!
gui.guhs.verblijf.info.geen_foto: No photo in your Safari-dex yet.

gui.guhs.verblijf.info.cooldown.nu: You may buy another sign of this kind.
gui.guhs.verblijf.bouw.uitleg: Later this animal can build for you. What it will be able to do:
gui.guhs.verblijf.bouw.geen: This animal is not a builder. It is very good at being cute, though.
gui.guhs.verblijf.bezorgen.uitleg: Your stork takes up to 9 stacks from the chest next to this sign to a friend's Stork Mailbox.
gui.guhs.verblijf.bezorgen.niemand: Nobody has a Stork Mailbox yet.
gui.guhs.verblijf.bezorgen.onderweg: The stork is on its way...
gui.guhs.verblijf.bezorgen.geen_kist: Put a chest right next to the sign (with something in it).
gui.guhs.verblijf.bezorgen.geen_bus: That friend has no Stork Mailbox (any more).
gui.guhs.verblijf.bezorgen.vol: The mailbox of %s is full: the stork brought the parcel back.
gui.guhs.verblijf.bezorgen.klaar: Your stork delivered the parcel to %s. Klepper klepper!
gui.guhs.verblijf.bezorgen.ontvangen: A stork from %s dropped a parcel in your Stork Mailbox!
gui.guhs.verblijf.terug_park: The animals went back to the safari park. Bye bye!
gui.guhs.verblijf.water_nodig: A %s needs water: at least %s water blocks around the sign.
gui.guhs.verblijf.niet_in_park: Signs belong at home, not in the safari park.
gui.guhs.verblijf.ei: Your ostrich laid a Giant Egg!
gui.guhs.verblijf.rijden: Sneak + right-click to ride. Hold on tight!
gui.guhs.verblijf.koop.geen_foto: Photograph a %s in the park first.
gui.guhs.verblijf.koop.cooldown: You can buy another %s sign in %s.
gui.guhs.verblijf.koop.gekocht: Enclosure sign bought: %s! Place it at home.
gui.guhs.verblijf.koop.geen_bord: There is no sign for this animal.
gui.guhs.verblijf.taak.dam: A dam with a beaver pond
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.leeuw: Lions sleep up to 20 hours a day. Nice and chonky.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.luipaard: A leopard drags its food up a tree, so nobody steals it.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.olifant: Elephants recognise each other after years. They never forget a cuddle.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.neushoorn: A rhino horn is made of the same stuff as your nails.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.kafferbuffel: Buffalo vote together which way the herd goes.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.dikdik: A dik-dik is only as big as a chonky cat.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.giraffe: A giraffe's tongue is bluish and up to 45 cm long.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.zebra: No two zebras have the same stripes.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.stokstaartje: Meerkats take turns keeping watch. Always upright!
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.jachtluipaard: The cheetah is the fastest land animal, but super sleepy after a sprint.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.struisvogel: An ostrich egg is as big as 24 chicken eggs. Giant omelette!
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.zeekoe: Manatees are related to... elephants! You can tell by the chonk.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.nijlpaard: Hippos can't swim: they walk along the bottom.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.flamingo: Flamingos are pink because of what they eat.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.capibara: Capybaras are friends with everyone. Really everyone.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.krokodil: A crocodile can stay under water for an hour, and smile at the same time.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.rode_panda: Red pandas use their fluffy tail as a blanket.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.reuzenpanda: A giant panda eats bamboo for about 12 hours a day. Vahoeg.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.gibbon: Gibbons sing a duet together in the morning.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.luiaard: Sloths only come down once a week to go to the toilet.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.okapi: The okapi looks like a zebra, but is related to the giraffe.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.orang_oetan: Orangutans build a new bed of leaves every evening.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.toekan: A toucan's beak is big, but very light.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.gekko: Geckos walk up walls thanks to tiny hairs on their toes.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.glimworm: Glow-worms make their tail glow to lure snacks.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.pinguin: Emperor penguins cuddle together against the cold: the huddle!
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.ijsbeer: A polar bear has black skin under its white fur.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.zeehond: Seals can sleep under water, with their nose shut.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.narwal: A narwhal's tusk can grow up to 3 metres long.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.octopus: An octopus has three hearts. Triple sweet!
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.sabeltandtijger: Sabre-tooth tigers lived in the ice age. Luckily this one is sweet.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.mammoet: A mammoth had thick fur and a layer of fat: extra chonk.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.wolharige_neushoo: The woolly rhino pushed snow aside with its horn.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.bever: Beavers have orange teeth: there's iron in them.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.vuursalamander: Fire salamanders love rain and wet stones.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.egel: A hedgehog has about 5000 spines. No cuddles without a glove.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.otter: Otters hold paws when they sleep, so they don't drift apart.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.das: A badger sett can be hundreds of years old.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.edelhert: A red deer grows new antlers every year.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.ooievaar: Storks clatter their beak to say hello.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.specht: A woodpecker taps up to 20 times a second. Tok tok tok!
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.koala: Koalas sleep up to 22 hours a day. Even chonkier than a lion.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.kangoeroe: A baby kangaroo is as big as a bean when it's born.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.wombat: Wombats make square droppings. Yes, really.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.quokka: The quokka is called the happiest animal in the world.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.prieelvogel: A male bowerbird decorates his bower with blue things.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.gouden_dikdik: A golden dik-dik? That doesn't exist. Except this one.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.kameleon: A chameleon can look two ways at once with its little eyes.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.reuzenschildpad: Giant tortoises can live past 150. Slow and steady, chonk.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.slang: A snake smells with its tongue. That's why it keeps sticking it out.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.hoornkikker: A horned frog is almost all mouth. Chomp!
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.kraaghagedis: When a frilled lizard gets a fright, it opens its frill and runs off on two legs.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.gifkikker: Poison dart frogs are so brightly coloured to say: don't eat me!
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.baardagaam: A bearded dragon waves its little paw to say hello.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.mier: An ant can lift 50 times its own weight. So strong!
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.springspin: A jumping spider has eight eyes and jumps 50 times its own length.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.wandelende_tak: A stick insect sways to and fro, just like a twig in the wind.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.mestkever: A dung beetle navigates by the stars. Yes, by the Milky Way!
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.slak: A snail has thousands of tiny teeth.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.vogelspin: A tarantula is fluffy like a plushie, but it doesn't like cuddles.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.hommel: A bumblebee buzzes so loud because it shivers its wings warm.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.kiwi: A kiwi is the only bird with nostrils at the tip of its beak.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.schubdier: A pangolin rolls into a ball when it's scared. A living pine cone!
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.spookdiertje: Each eye of a tarsier is bigger than its brain.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.plompe_lori: The slow loris does everything very, very, very slowly. Chonk to the bone.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.fruitvleermuis: Fruit bats sleep upside down, wrapped in their wings like a blanket.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.galago: A bushbaby jumps up to two metres high. Boing!
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.suikereekhoorn: A sugar glider glides from tree to tree with a skin flap between its legs.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.fennek: With its giant ears a fennec fox can even hear a beetle walking under the sand.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.zeepaardje: With seahorses, the dad has the babies. Nice for mum!
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.pijlstaartrog: A stingray 'flies' under water with its big fins.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.zeeschildpad: Sea turtles swim thousands of kilometres and always find their way back to their beach.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.clownvis: A clownfish lives safely among the stinging arms of an anemone.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.kwal: Jellyfish have no brain, no heart and no bones. Very pretty though.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.kogelvis: A pufferfish puffs up into a spiky ball when it's startled.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.zeester: A starfish can grow back an arm. And the sea urchins are its best friends.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.babyhaai: Sharks have rows of teeth: when one falls out, the next one moves forward.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.regenboogvis: Rainbowfish swim in a school: together they turn like one big fish.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.lantaarnvisje: A lanternfish makes its own light, deep in the dark sea.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.dumbo_octopus: The Dumbo octopus flaps its little ears, just like the elephant from the film.
gui.guhs.verblijf.feit.pelikaan: A pelican's throat pouch holds more than its stomach. Gobble!
